name: M3_OIS010MI_Cpy
description: Copy an existing customer order type to a new customer order type with the same settings. The copy operation creates a new order type based on a specified source order type and a new target identity. Core control parameters are duplicated, and you can also include related documents, charges, default settings, and user-defined text depending on the options you send. The operation does not return any field data; it only performs the copy.

inputParameters.name: ORTP
inputParameters.description: Existing customer order type to copy from.

inputParameters.name: CORT
inputParameters.description: New customer order type to create by copying the existing type.

inputParameters.name: ICTR
inputParameters.description: Indicates whether the new order type should be flagged for internal sales.

inputParameters.name: DOCP
inputParameters.description: Indicates whether connected order documents should be copied to the new order type.

inputParameters.name: OCCP
inputParameters.description: Indicates whether connected order type charges should be copied to the new order type.

inputParameters.name: DFCP
inputParameters.description: Indicates whether order type field selection and default settings should be copied to the new order type.

inputParameters.name: TXCP
inputParameters.description: Indicates whether user-defined texts attached to the order type should be copied to the new order type.
